parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance with all covenants as of September 30, 2026. The limits at 2026-09-30 come from the 'thereafter' terms of the Third Amendment schedule. The minimum liquidity limit is in $ millions. The excerpt also lists earlier step-down limits for March 2025 through March 2026, which are not reported here as separate entries. The Credit Agreement was later repaid in full and terminated using proceeds from the Blue Torch Financing Agreement. The Blue Torch covenants are not reported because they first apply to the quarter ending December 31, 2026: maximum Leverage Ratio of 4.50:1.00 stepping down to 2.00:1.00, minimum FCCR of 1.00:1.00 rising to 1.20:1.00, and minimum average weekly liquidity of $7.5M, then $5.0M. Leverage-based margin and excess cash flow sweep thresholds are not covenants and are excluded.
